Eden Park: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight gate for the Snow+DBX+Qdrant connector pilot. Goal: publish marketplace listing + run 3 customer validation runs in parallel. Who can own ops for each integration?

Marco Rivera: I can take Databricks side (deploy + test notebooks). Need the connector image + compatibility matrix.

Priya Patel: I’ll own Snowflake onboarding (schema mapping + sample ingestion). ETA for test datasets?

Samir Gupta: I’ll handle Qdrant validation and embedding pipeline perf. One ask: we need quantized inference profile from infra to size pods.

Jenna Morales: I can coordinate the marketplace listing copy and legal checklist. Also we should prep a joint announcement plan — who’s owning press embargo?

Eden Park: Nice — action items: Marco (DBX infra), Priya (Snow ingest), Samir (Qdrant perf), Jenna (GTM + legal). I’ll own timeline + pilot recruitment. Proposed timeline:
```
Week 0: internal smoke + compatibility matrix
Week 1-2: pilot customer onboards (3 pilots)
Week 3: perf regressions + doc updates
Week 4: marketplace listing + joint announcement
```

Marco Rivera: FYI infra needs: `g4dn.xlarge` equivalent for perf tests, will request dedicated capacity for 3 days per pilot.

integrations-bot: deploy-job #4992 completed: connector-image:v2026-03-18 pushed to staging. link: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/4992

Priya Patel: Dataset note — use `sales_demo_2026` (anonymized). I’ll drop a sample ingest script here shortly.

Samir Gupta: For Qdrant, memory + SSD matters. Suggest we run embedding batch sizes [32,64] and record latency & disk IOPS. I’ll post the validation checklist.

Jenna Morales: On announcements — recommend soft launch to partner channels first, then wider PR. I’ll draft the timeline and share by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

Eden Park: Can everyone drop an explicit blocker by EOD? If none, I’ll book a 30m sync for Monday to lock the microscope plan. @Marco @Priya @Samir @Jenna

Marco Rivera: Blocker: confirmation of GPU quota. I’ll ping infra.

Priya Patel: Blocker: sample data access for one pilot org — waiting on legal sign-off.

Samir Gupta: No blockers from my side aside from infra perf profile (Samir -> infra ticket created).

Jenna Morales: No blockers — legal checkpoint scheduled Thu.

Eden Park: Great — booking meeting now. Thanks all. :sparkles:
